base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' AND b.XCL_006 = '=' 
        THEN a.XCL_001 
        ELSE NULL 
    END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
LEFT JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m2.XCL_010 
    FROM molecule m2
    JOIN atom a2 ON m2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_002
    WHERE m2.XCL_011 = '-' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'ca'
)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'C' AND c.XCL_009 = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
LEFT JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007 OR a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a2
    WHERE a2.XCL_002 = a.XCL_002
      AND a2.XCL_003 = 'Ca'
  )
